Binary decodes of 120 permutations
Bit mapping: layer0(dark1)=1, layer1(dark3)=0, all content=1
Per-pixel stacking: highest priority color wins, then bit counted per 20x20 cell
8x5 grid of 20x20, read L->R, T->B
